hints.environment: Sandbox takes test payments, Live takes real ones.
hints.clientId: From your app under Apps & Credentials in the PayPal Developer Dashboard.
hints.clientSecret: Shown next to the client ID in your app in the PayPal Developer Dashboard.
hints.webhookId: Verifies PayPal webhook notifications. From the Webhooks section of your app in the PayPal Developer Dashboard.
hints.intent: With Capture right away, the payment is one-stage and the money is debited right away. With Authorize only, it is two-stage and the amount is held until you capture it.
hints.brandName: Shown on PayPal pages instead of the business name of your PayPal account.
hints.landingPage: The first page the customer sees in PayPal.
hints.softDescriptor: Added after your business name on the customer's card statement.
hints.sendItems: Sends the cart's items, shipping, tax and discount to PayPal, shown to the customer and in your PayPal account.
